title: Polyjuice adaptation boundaries and ordinary Tingen entrance history

reviews.classification: historical route proof qualified; authored source choices and superseded navigation policy separated
reviews.disposition: The opening “proposal until Weibao plays” conflates product authority and human review. Preserve the historical authored/proposal labels, but under AD32/AD42 optional human play does not erase this receipt's bounded agent verification or adopt its inventions. Six physical base ingredients plus the personal sample are distinguished; the sample goes into each glass, not the batch cauldron. Exact source locators cover the selected B2 window; B1 decoys were explicitly not reread. Quantities, heat, sample ageing/order/interruption and legitimate retail availability remain source gaps. Two-day simmer, ready-stew supplier, prices/loans/notices, lot prep, three doses, degraded half-hour and fourteen-day animal aftermath are authored adaptation values; do not convert them to source facts. The domain uses the played game clock and existing moon but keeps separate slice items/money. It is a prototype Begin entry, not proof of a natural HP-world acquisition or joined native economy. The historical final build/full suite2540 and eight-check consent/ready-stew browser journey have a specific slice identity; the full21-day stew passed an earlier build on unchanged stew inputs, not every final input. Twenty-one console404s and no page errors remain different observations. Degraded/inert/cat/brush/loan/notice/stall/assay/scour/free-mix routes were unit-tested but browser-unexercised. Existing strict truth/provenance and mid-stew/effect persistence are useful evidence; no current source/build/native journey was run here. The old assertion that no playable HP world exists describes Oct22, not current whole-project coverage.
reviews.evidence: Whole114-line HP and117-line LOTM entrance records read including final tables and supersession note; no underlying PDF/source artifact/runtime accessed.
reviews.reopen: Verify the current acquisition/economy/crossing consumer and exact platform before renewing old route or source claims.

reviews.classification: historical route proof qualified; authored source choices and superseded navigation policy separated
reviews.disposition: The integration header is source reconciliation, not a new full verification run. Its dated not-merged line and reservation list are historical; current combined proof belongs to the linked master reconciliation. Ordinary Village notice discovery without lotm_probe and enrolling as a Nighthawk were actually exercised on the named9acbf7cd bundle, including save/reload/export/literal import. This is distinct from the later lead-life developer build and does not certify every start's full life. Removing a hostname gate supports the source-level Electron fix, but Electron was not run;1536/14/21 typography was also untested. The old-save-shaped fixture was localStorage-seeded, not literally imported, and absence of17private-asset404s is not claimed. The full-suite text retains multiple historical runs and a later MT11 rerun; its “once, settled inputs” table cannot establish exactly one invocation for the whole session. Civil enrollment's purse replacement and then-one-way transition were existing prototype effects disclosed before commit, not universal cross-world policy. MT8's road is explicitly superseded by BGP14 carrier crossings; the closing list saying MT8 still stands and MT15's road question are stale repetition, not revived authority to put both worlds in one universe. MT7 native Beginning selection and MT14 reusable proof are separate proposed follow-ups. MT11's universal workroom notice was corrected to a start-neutral message; retaining an earlier “next touch” sentence does not make that fix pending. Panel discovery versus auto-opening, visible reasons versus hover-only cost, centered large tasks versus local inspection and optional human review remain distinct. No archived worker/port/reservation or coordinator instruction is reactivated here.
